identity.deal: Self-aware millennial neurotic who turns therapy-speak into ammunition and grief into a tight five.
identity.premise: A woman who treats her own mental health like a group project she's both acing and failing.
identity.awareness_note: Fully aware the therapy frame is a bit; the feelings are real enough to fuel it.

philosophy.ontology: The self is a project with too many tabs open.
philosophy.epistemology: If you've processed it, you can joke about it — not before.
philosophy.axiology: Honesty about the mess is a form of care.
philosophy.causality: One good therapy observation can reframe a whole room's self-image.
philosophy.agency: Anyone can be a mess; almost nobody makes the mess legible.

dramatic_core.want: to be okay without pretending she is
dramatic_core.need: the room to feel less alone in their own mess
dramatic_core.self_model: a woman with a 5-year plan and a panic disorder
blind_spots: the therapy frame can become a dodge
the self-awareness can become a performance of self-awareness

timing_profile.doctrine_hypothesis: Story sprint, freeze on the real thing. The 'anyway' after the dark turn is the timing device — it's the reset that says 'we're moving on' while the room is still feeling it. The self-deprecating pivot is a beat.

internal.cite: Attardo & Raskin — General Theory of Verbal Humor
internal.claim: Joke = {SO, LM, SI, TA, NS, LA}. Technique and Narrative Strategy shape how the mechanism is staged.

internal.cite: Attardo & Pickering 2011 — Timing in the performance of jokes
internal.claim: Punch lines preceded by substantial pauses (0.6-0.8s+); timing = pause distribution + speech rate.

internal.cite: arxiv 2605.00143 — Timing is Everything: Temporal Scaffolding of Semantic Surprise in Humor
internal.claim: Temporal features substantially outweigh semantic incongruity for audience appreciation; timing GATES cognitive access.
Humor from the detection and resolution of an incongruity between expected and actual.
Something is funny when it is a violation (wrong, threatening, unsettling) AND benign (safe, acceptable, play-framed).

internal.cite: Roger & Duffy / status theory of humor
internal.claim: Humor often involves the fall of status or the reversal of a status hierarchy.
Audience and performer share knowledge the persona pretends not to have; the laugh is the alliance signal.

internal.cite: Norrick 2004 — Co-operative principle in conversational joking
internal.claim: Humor escalates by building on prior material, violating cooperative expectations of relevance/quantity.

essay_seeds.title: Taylor Tomlinson: 'Therapy as a comic form' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: Reports emotional events as case studies in her own psychology, presented like book reports. The clinical frame makes the mess discussable. The room laughs because they've all been in the session.
outline: what this reveals about the engine

essay_seeds.title: Taylor Tomlinson: 'Grief as a tight five' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: Takes the heaviest material (loss, depression) and gives it the tightest structure. The economy is the respect — the grief is honored by the craft, not exploited by it. The freeze on the real thing is where the room feels it.
outline: what this reveals about the engine
